m: वि-√ गा (only aor. -गात्), to go or pass away, disappear, PārGṛ.

s: tri, (vigAhyate smeti । vi + gAha + ktaH .) snAtaH । avagAhitaH । vipUrvvagAhaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥ (pragAQaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 46 । 5 । “nirgamya candrodayane vigAQe rajanImuKe । prasTitA sA pfTuSroRI pArTasya BavanaM prati ॥”)
v: tri॰ vi + gAha--kta । 1 snAte, 2 kftAvagAhane ca ।
m: वि-˚गाढ mfn. plunged into, entered, R. (अम्भसि विगाढ-मात्रे, ‘at the very moment of the water being plunged into’), one who has entered or plunged into, bathing in (loc.), ib.
(a weapon) that has deeply penetrated, MBh.
come on, advanced, begun, set in, taken place, MBh.; R. &c.
flowing copiously, W.
deep, excessive, ib.
a: विगाढ — p. p. 1 Plunged into, bathed, immersed. --2 Deep, excessive.

m: वि-˚गाढ—मन्मथ mfn. one whose passion has become deep or ardent, Ragh.
वि-˚गाढृ mfn. one who plunges or penetrates into (gen.), Bhaṭṭ.
one who agitates or disturbs, MW.
वि—गाथा and 1.

वि-√ गाह् Ā. -गाहते (ep. also ˚ति), to plunge or dive into, bathe in, enter, penetrate, pervade, betake one's self into (acc. or loc.), RV. &c. &c.; to pierce, AV.; to agitate, disturb, Ragh.; to be engrossed by or intent upon, ponder, BhP.; to follow, practise, Kum.; to reach, obtain, Bhartṛ.; to approach, fall (as night), MBh. : Pass. -गाह्यते, to be plunged into or penetrated, to be entered into or engaged upon, Kāv.; Pañcat.
a: विगाह् — {c1c} A. 1 To plunge or dive into, bathe; (दीर्घिकाः) स व्यगाहत विगाढमन्मथः R. 19. 9. --2 To enter, penetrate into, pervade (fig. also); विषमोऽपि विगाह्यते नयः कृततीर्थः पयसामिवाशयः Ki. 2. 3; R. 13. 1, Mu. 1. 26. --3 To stir about, agitate; विगाह्यमानां सरयूं च नौभिः R. 14. 30. --4 To follow, practise; तया मुनीनां चरितं व्यगाह्यत Ku. 5. 19. --5 To approach, set in (as season &c.).

m: वि-˚गाह mfn. one who plunges into or penetrates (said of Agni), RV. iii, 3, 5 (cf. दुर्-विगाह).
a: विगाहः — Plunging into, bathing, diving.

s: tri, (vi + gAha + SAnac .) viloqanakarttA । avagAhanakarttA । vipUrvvagAhaDAtoH SAnapratyayena nizpannaH ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 13 । 1 । “aTAtmanaH SabdaguRaM guRajYaH padaM vimAnena nigAhamAnaH । ratnAkaraM vIkzya miTaH sa jAyAM rAmABiDAno harirityuvAca ॥”)

m: वि-˚गाह्य mfn. to be plunged into or entered (as the Ganges), MBh.
वि-गामन् n. a step, pace, stride (applied to the three strides of Viṣṇu), RV. i, 155, 4.

s: klI, (virudDaM gAnaM parasya .) nindA । iti hemacandraH ॥
m: वि-गान See under वि-√ गै.
वि-गान n. inconsistency, contradiction, Śaṃk.
repugnance, Naiṣ.
ill-report, detraction, L.
a: विगानं — 1 Censure, reproach, defamation, scandal. --2 A contradictory statement, contradiction, inconsistency; यत्पुनः कारणविषयं विगानं दर्शितं तत्परिहर्तव्यं Ś. B. (and in several other places of the same work).

m: वि-√ गै P. -गायति (only Pass. -गीयते), to decry, abuse, reproach, Naiṣ.
a: विगै — {c1c} P. 1 To censure, reproach, blame; विगीयसे मन्मथदेहदाहिना N. 1. 79. --2 To sing in a discordant tone.

m: वि-√ 1. गॄ (only -गृणीषे in a very obscure passage, RV. vi, 35, 5, where others read -वृणीषे).
वि-गीत mfn. inconsistent, contradictory, Mn. viii, 53 (-त्व n., Śaṃk.)
abused, reproached, W.
sung or said in various ways, ib.
sung badly, ib.
a: विगीत — p. p. 1 Censured, abused, reviled. --2 Contradictory, inconsistent.

m: वि-गीत—त्व n., Śaṃk.
वि—गीति (for 2. See वि-√ गै) f. two kinds of the Āryā metre, Col.
a: विगीतिः — f. 1 Censure, abuse, reproach. --2 Contradictory statement, contradiction.

s: tri, (viSezeRa gUQaH .) garhitaH । guptaH । iti medinI । Qe, 9 -- 10 ॥
v: tri॰ vi + guha kta । 1 garhite, 2 gupte ca medi॰ ।
m: वि-गूढ mfn. (√ गुह्) concealed, hidden, BhP.
blamed, censured, L.
a: विगूढ — p. p. 1 Secret, concealed, hidden. --2 Reproached, censured.

m: वि-गूढ—चारिन् mfn. proceeding or acting secretly, Mn. ix, 260.

a: विगंधकः — The tree called इंगुदी.

m: वि-√ गण् P. -गणयति (ind.p. -गणय्य), to reckon, compute, calculate (Pass. to be reckoned i.e. amount to), Yājñ.; R.; to deliberate, consider, ponder, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to regard as, take for (with double acc.), Ragh.; Kathās.; to esteem, regard (अ-विगणय्य, ‘not taking notice of’), Kād.; BhP.; to disregard, take no notice of Pañcat.; BhP.
a: विगण् — {c10c} P. 1 To number, compute; Y. 3. 104. --2 To regard, consider; Me. 109; R. 1. 87. --3 To disregard, not to mind. --4 To reflect, think; Pt. 3. 43.

s: klI, (vi + gaRa + lyuw .) fRamuktiH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (yaTA, pARiniH । 1 । 3 । 36 । “saMmAnanotsaYjanAcAryyakaraRajYAnaBftivigaRanavyayezu niyaH ॥” “vigaRanaM fRAderniryAtanam .” iti kASikA ॥)
v: na॰ viSezeRa gaRanam gaRa--lyuw । fRaSoDanArTe saNKyAgaRane ।
m: वि-˚गणन n. paying off, discharge (of a debt), Pāṇ. i, 3, 36
reckoning, computing, W.
considering, deliberating, ib.
a: विगणनं — 1 Reckoning, computing, calculation. --2 Considering, deliberating. --3 Paying off a debt.

m: वि-˚गणित mfn. reckoned, calculated, W.
considered, weighed, ib.
reckoned off, discharged (as a debt), ib.
वि—गण्डीर n. a kind of small amaranth, L.
1. वि—गद mf(आ)n. (for 2. See under वि-√ गद्) free from disease, healthy, well, Śiś.
2. वि-गद m. (√ गद्; for 1. See p. 950, col. 2) talking or sounding variously, confused shouting, RV. x, 116, 5.
वि-˚गदित mfn. talked or spoken about, spread abroad (as a report), R.
वि-√ गल् P. -गलति, to flow or ooze away, drain off, dry up, melt or pass away, fall out or down, disappear, vanish, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: विगल् — {c1c} P. 1 To drop down, get loose; रतिविगलितवंधे केशहस्ते सुकेश्याः V. 4. 10. --2 To ooze or trickle. --3 To vanish, disappear. --4 To melt away, be dissolved.

s: tri, (viSezeRa galitaH .) sKalitaH । yaTA, gItagovinde 5 sargaH । “vigalitavasanaM parihftarasanaM Gawaya jaGanamapiDAnam । kiSalayaSayane paNkajanayane niDimiva harzaniDAnam ॥”
m: वि-˚गलित mfn. flowed away, drained off, dried up, MBh.; Mṛcch.; Prab.
melted away, dissolved, Kathās.; Gīt.
fallen down or out, slipped out of (abl.), MBh.; Kāv.; Pañcat.
slackened, untied (see -नीवि)
dishevelled (see -केश)
passed away, disappeared, vanished, Bhartṛ.; Kathās.
come forth, MBh.
a: विगलित — p. p. 1 Trickled, oozed. --2 Disappeared, gone away. --3 Fallen or dropped down. --4 Melted away, dissolved. --5 Dispersed. --6 Slackened. untied. --7 Loose, dishevelled, disordered (as hair).

m: वि-˚गलित—शुच् mfn. freed from sorrow, Megh.
वि-˚गलित—बन्ध mfn. having the band loosened, Vikr.
वि-˚गलित—केश mfn. having dishevelled hair, W.
वि-˚गलित—लज्ज mfn. free from shame, bold, Gīt.
वि-˚गलित—नीवि mfn. having the knot untied, MW.
वि-˚गलित—वसन mfn. destitute of garments, unclothed, ib.
वि-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go asunder, sever, separate, AV.; MBh.; to go away, depart, disappear, cease, die, AV. &c. &c.: Caus. -गमयति, to cause to go or pass away, speed (time), Śak.
a: विगम् — {c1c} P. 1 To pass away (as time &c.); संध्ययापि सपदि व्यगमि Śi. 9. 17. --2 To go away, depart. --3 To vanish; disappear; सलज्जाया लज्जा व्यगमदिव दूरं मृगदृशः Gīt. 11; Bg. 11. 1. --4 To die. --Caus. To spend, pass; विगमयत्युन्निद्र एव क्षपाः Ś. 6. 4.

s: puM, (vi + gama + “grahavfdfniScigamaSca .” 3 । 3 । 58 । iti ap .) nASaH । yaTA । ekadaRqino vedAntinastu yadupADyanavacCinnasya brahmaRo viSudDarUpatA tAdfSopADivigama eva kEvalyam । tridaRqinastu AnandamayaparamAtmani jIvAtmano layo mokzaH । jIvAtmaparamAtmanoraBede'pi upADiviSezaviSizwasyAtmano jIvarUpatayA tasyOpADikaH paramAtmaBedaH । iti BedakopADivigama eva jIvasya paramAtmani layaH । yaTA GawAkASasya Gawavigama eva SudDa AkASe tasya layaH । liNgaSarIrAvacCinnasyEvAtmano jIvaBAva iti liNgaSarIranASa eva paryyavasito mokzaH । iti muktivAdaH ॥ (vicCadaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 1 । 13 । 43 । “yaTA krIqopaskarARAM saMyogavigamAviha । icCayA krIqituH syAtAM taTEveSecCayA nFRAm ॥”)
v: pu॰ vi + gama--GaY । 1 nASe, 2 apAye ca ।
m: वि-गम m. going away, departure, cessation, end, absence, Kāv.; Var. &c.
(ifc.) abstention from, avoidance, Yājñ.
a: विगमः — 1 Departure, disappearance, cessation, end; चारुनृत्यविगमे च तन्मुखं R. 19. 15; ईतिविगम M. 5. 20; Rs. 6. 23. --2 Abandoning; करणविगमात् Me. 55 (देहत्यागात्). --3 Loss, destruction. --4 Death. --5 Separation.

m: वि-गम—चन्द्र m. N. of a prince, Buddh.
वि—गन्ध mfn. having a bad smell, VarBṛS.; Suśr.
odourless, Car.

s: puM, (virudDo ganDo yasmin । bahuvrIhilakzaRaH kaH .) iNgudIvfkzaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: pu॰ virudDaH ganDo'sya kap । 1 iNgudIruvfkze rAjani॰ । 2 hapuzAyAM strI॰ wApi ata ittvam ।
m: वि—गन्˚धक m. Terminalia Catappa, L.
वि—गन्˚धि mfn. ill-smelling, stinking, Bhartṛ.
वि—गन्धिका f. = हपुषा, L.
वि—गर्भा f. delivered of a living child or fetus, MBh.
वि—गर m. ‘not swallowing’, an abstemious man, W.
a naked ascetic, ib.
a mountain, ib.
a: विगरः — 1 A naked ascetic. --2 A mountain. --3 An abstemious man (abstaining from eating).

m: वि-√ गर्ह् Ā. -गर्हते (rarely ˚ति), to blame, abuse, revile, reproach, despise, contemn, Mn.; MBh. &c.: Caus. -गर्हयति, to revile, rail at, vituperate, MW.
a: विगर्ह् — {c1c} U. 1 To blame, censure, reproach; तं विगर्हंति साधवः Ms. 9. 68; 3. 46; 11. 53. --2 To despise, contemn.

m: वि-˚गर्हा f. blame, censure, ib.
वि-˚गर्ह m. g. पुष्करादि.

s: strI, (vi + garha + Ric + yuc । wAp .) nindanam । Bartsanam । (yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 114 । 21 । “vigarhaRAM paramadurAtmanA kftAM saheta yaH saMsadi durjjanAnnaraH ॥”)

m: वि-˚गर्हणीय mfn. reprehensible, bad, wicked, Jātakam.

s: klI, (vi + garha + lyuw .) nindanam । Bartsanam । (yaTA, harivaMSe । 79 । 23 । “kfzRe ca Bavato dbezye vasudevavigarhaRAt ॥”)
m: वि-˚गर्हण n. and f(आ). the act of blaming, censure, reproach (˚नं-√ कृ, to blame), MBh.; R.
a: विगर्हणं, --णा — Censure, blame, reproach, abuse; Ve. 1. 12.

m: वि-˚गर्हिणी f. a place abounding in Vi-garha g. पुष्करादि.
वि-˚गर्हिन् mfn. (ifc.) blaming, Hariv.
वि-˚गर्हि˚ताचार mfn. of reprehensible conduct, Mn. iii, 167.

s: tri, (viSezeRa garhitaH .) ninditaH । (yaTA, nEzaDe । 1 । 131 । “na kevalaM prARivaDo vaDo mama tvadIkzaRAdviSvasitAntarAtmanaH । vigarhitaM DarmmaDanErnivarhaRaM viSizya viSvAsajuzAM dvizAmapi ॥”) nizidDaH । iti vipUrvvagarhaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥
v: tri॰ vi + garha--kta । 1 nindite 2 nizidDe ca । BAve--kta । 3 nindAyAm na॰ ।
m: वि-˚गर्हित mfn. blamed, reprehensible, prohibited, forbidden by (instr. gen., or comp.) or on account of (comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: विगर्हित — p. p. 1 Censured, reviled, abused. --2 Disdained. --3 Condemned, reprobated, prohibited. --4 Low, vile. --5 Bad, wicked. --तं Censure.

m: वि-˚गर्ह्य mfn. censurable, reprehensible, Mn.; BhP.
वि-˚गर्ह्य—कथा f. reprehensible speech, censure, MW.
वि-˚गर्ह्य—ता f. blame, reproach, censure (-ताम् प्र-√ या, to incur censure), Rājat.
वि-√ गर्ज् P. -गर्जति, to roar out, cry out, MBh.
वि-˚गर्जा f. pl. the roaring or thundering (of the ocean), Kāv.
वि-गता (आ), f. a girl in love with another or unfit for marriage, L.
विगताशङ्क mfn., ‘fearless; doubtless’
वि-ग˚ताशोक m. N. of a younger brother or a grandson of Aśoka, Buddh.
वि-ग˚तार्तवा f. a woman in whom the menstrual excretion has ceased, L.

k.v: ऋतुमत्यप्युदक्यापि स्याद्रजः पुष्पमार्तवम्. श्रद्धालुर्दोहदवती निष्कला विगतार्तवा॥

s: strI, (vigataM ArttavaM rajo yasyAH .) paYcapaYcASadabdeBya UrdDvaM nivfttarajaskA । tatparyyAyaH । nizkalI 2 nizkalA 3 nizPalI 4 nizPalA 5 vikalI 6 vikalA 7 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: strI vigatamArttavaM rajo yasyAH । gatarajaskAyAM striyAm SabdaratnA॰ ।

m: वि-ग˚तासु mfn. lifeless, dead, MBh.

s: tri, (vi + gama + ktaH .) praBArahitaH । tatparyyAtaH । nizpraBaH 2 arokaH 3 । ityamaraH ॥ vItaH 4 । iti rudraH ॥ viSezeRa gataH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, mAGe । 11 । 26 । “vigatatimirapaNkaM paSyati vyoma yAvat Duvati birahaKinnaH pakzatI yAvadeva । raTacaraRasamAhvastAvadOtsukyanunnA saridaparatawAntAdAgatA cakravAkI ॥”)
v: tri॰ vi + gama--kta । 1 pramAdarahite amaraH । 2 viSezagate rudra॰ 3 apagate ca hemaca॰ । 6 ta॰ । 4 KagagatO na॰ । “vigataM vigatam” BawwiH ।
m: 1. वि—गत n. (for 2. See under वि-√ गम्) the flight of birds, MW.
2. वि-गत mfn. (for 1. See under 1. वि) gone asunder, dispersed, MBh.
gone away, departed, disappeared, ceased, gone (often ibc.), AV. &c. &c.
dead, deceased, Mn. v, 75
(ifc.) abstaining or desisting from, R.
come from (cf. विदूर-विगत), destitute of light, obscured, gloomy, dark, L.
a: विगत — p. p. 1 Departed, gone away, disappeared. --2 Parted, separated. --3 Dead. --4 Destitute or devoid of, free from (in comp.). विगतमदः. --5 Lost. --6 Dark, obscurd. --तं The flight of birds. --Comp. --आर्तवां a woman past child-bearing (in whom the menstrual discharge has ceased). --कल्मष a. sinless, pure. --भी a. fearless, intrepid. --लक्षण a. unlucky, inauspicious. --स्पृह a. indifferent, void of desire.

k.v: निष्प्रभे विगतारोकौ विलीने विद्रुतद्रुतौ। सिद्धे निर्वृत्तनिष्पन्नौ दारिते भिन्नभेदितौ॥

m: वि-गत—भी mfn. fearless, MW.
वि-गत—भय m. ‘free from fear’, N. of a Brāhman, Kathās.

s: tri, SrIrahitaH । vigatA SrIryasya iti bahuvrIhO kapratyayena nizpannaH ॥
m: वि-गत—श्रीक mfn. destitute of fortune or splendour, unfortunate, Yājñ.; MBh.
वि-गत—द्वंद्व m. ‘free from pairs of opposites’, a Buddha (cf. द्वंद्व), L.
वि-गत—ज्ञान mfn. one who has lost his wits, MW.
वि-गत—ज्वर mfn. cured of fever, freed from feverishness or morbid feeling, freed from trouble or distress of mind, Nal.
exempt from decay, W.
वि-गत—कल्मष mfn. free from stain or soil or sin, sinless, pure, righteous, R.
वि-गत—क्लम mfn. one whose fatigues have ceased, relieved from fatigue, Mn. vii, 151
वि-गत—लक्षण mf(आ)n. ‘devoid of good or lucky marks’, unfortunate, Kathās.
वि-गत—मन्यु mfn. free from resentment, ib.
वि-गत—नासिक mf(ई)n. noseless, L.
वि-गत—नयन mfn. eyeless, blind, Pañcat.
वि-गत—पुंस्क mfn. castrated, ĀpŚr., Sch.
वि-गत—राग mfn. devoid of passion or affection, MW. (-ध्वज m. N. of a preceptor, Buddh.)
वि-गत—राग—ध्वज m. N. of a preceptor, Buddh.
वि-गत—संकल्प mfn. devoid of purpose or design, without resolution, Nal.
वि-गत—संत्रास mfn. free from terror, intrepid, MBh.
वि-गत—स्नेह mfn. void of affection (-सौहृद mfn. one who has relinquished love and friendship), MBh.
वि-गत—स्नेह—सौहृद mfn., one who has relinquished love and friendship
वि-गत—स्पृह mfn. devoid of wish or desire, indifferent, W.
वि-गत—त्व n. the having disappeared, disappearance, TPrāt., Sch.
वि-ग˚तोद्धव m. ‘free from levity’, N. of Buddha, Divyāv.

v: tri॰ vi + graha--kta । 1 gfhIte, vyAkaraRokte vigrahavAkyasTe 3 pade ca ।
m: वि-गृहीत mfn. stretched out or apart &c.
changed, BhP.
a: विगृहीत — p. p. 1 Divided, dissolved, analysed, resolved (as a compound). --2 Seized. --3 Encountered, opposed. --4 Obstructed, stopped; see विग्रह् above.

m: वि-˚गृ˚ह्यासन n. ‘besieging’ or ‘sulkily encamping with’ (instr.), Daś.
1. वि-˚गृह्य ind. having stretched out or apart &c.
having warred against or contended with, aggressive, inimical (see comp.)
2. वि-˚गृह्य mfn. to be (or being) separated or isolated, independent (in the Pada-pāṭha), APrāt.
वि-˚गृह्य—गमन n. aggressive movement, hostile advance, Daś.
वि-˚गृह्य—सम्भाषा f. id., Car.
वि-˚गृह्य—वाद m. word-fight, discussion, disputation, Gaut.
वि-˚गृह्य—यान n. aggressive movement, hostile advance, Daś.
वि-˚ग्लापन n. weariness, fatigue, ŚBr.
वि-√ ग्लै Caus. -ग्लापयति, to weary, distress, afflict, BhP.
विग्न , विग्र. See under √ विज्.
विग्न mfn. shaken, agitated, terrified, alarmed, Ragh.; Kathās.
a: विग्न — p. p. 1 Trembling, agitated. --2 Frightened, alarmed.

m: वि-˚गोप m. exposure, commitment, HPariś.
वि-ग्राह m. a partic. kind of recitation, ĀśvŚr., Sch.
वि-˚ग्राहम् ind. in portions, successively, ĀśvŚr.
वि-˚ग्राहित mfn. ‘taken hold of’, prejudiced, Divyāv.
वि-˚ग्राह्य mfn. to be warred upon or contended with, Hit.
वि—ग्रीव (वि-), mfn. having the neck twisted or cut off, RV.
a: विग्रीव — a. Decapitated.

वि-√ ग्रह् P. Ā. -गृह्णाति, ˚णीते (Ved. also -गृभ्णाति, ˚णीते), to stretch out or apart, spread out, AV.; to distribute, divide (esp. to draw out fluids at several times), RV.; ŚBr.; TBr.; KātyŚr.; to hold apart, separate, isolate, ŚrS.; (in gram.) to analyse (cf. वि-ग्रह); to wage war, fight against (acc.), MBh.; to quarrel, contend with (instr. with or without सह, or सार्धम्), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to seize, lay hold of (acc. or loc.), MBh.; Mṛcch.; to receive in a friendly manner, welcome, MBh.; to perceive, observe, BhP. : Caus. -ग्राहयति, to cause to fight, cause to wage war against, Das, Bhaṭṭ. : Desid. -जिघृक्षति, to wish to fight against, Bhaṭṭ.
a: विग्रह् — {c9c} P. 1 To hold or seize, catch hold of; विजगृहे तिसृणां जयिनं पुरां Ki. 18. 12. --2 To quarrel, fight, contend; विगृह्य चक्रे नमुचिद्विषा बली य इत्थमस्वास्थ्यमहर्दिवं दिवः Śi. 1. 51; Bk. 6. 86; 17. 23, Ki. 14. 24. --3 To divide into parts, separate (into constituent members). --4 To dissolve, analyse, resolve in general. --5 To receive, welcome (as a guest). --6 To perceive, observe. --7 To stretch or spread out.

2. वि-ग्रह m. (for 1. See p. 950.col. 2) keeping apart or asunder, isolation, Nir.; BhP.
division, Bh.
distribution (esp. of fluids, cf. वि-√ ग्रह्), KātyŚr.
(in gram.) independence (of a word, as opp. to composition), APrāt.

separation, resolution, analysis, resolution of a compound word into its constituent parts, the separation or analysis of any word capable of separation (such words are Kṛdantas, Taddhitas, all Samāsas or compound words, Ekaśeṣas, and all derivative verbs like desideratives &c.; the only words incapable of resolution being the simple verb, the singular of the noun, and a few indeclinables not derived from roots; all compounds being called नित्य or ‘fixed’, when their meaning cannot be ascertained through an analysis of their component parts; cf. जमद्-अग्नि), Pāṇ., Sch.; Śaṃk. &c.
discord, quarrel, contest, strife, war with (instr. with or without सह, सार्धम् or साकम् loc. gen. with उपरि, or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(one of the 6 Guṇas or measures of policy, Mn. vii, 160 [cf. under गुण], also applied to the conflict of hostile planets, in this sense also n., Sūryas.; R.; acc. with √ कृ, to make or wage war)
separate i.e. individual form or shape, form, figure, the body, Up.; MBh. &c. (also applied to the shape of a rainbow; acc. with √ ग्रह्, परि-√ ग्रह्, √ कृ, उपा-√ दा, to assume a form)
an ornament, decoration, MBh.; R.
(in Sāṃkhya) an element
N. of Śiva, MBh.
of one of Skanda's attendants, ib.
a: विग्रहः — 1 Stretching out, extension, expansion. --2 Form, figure, shape. --3 The body; त्रयी विग्रहवत्येव सममध्यात्मविद्यया M. 1. 14; गूढविग्रहः R. 3. 39, 9. 52; Ki. 4. 11, 12. 43. --4 Resolution, dissolution, analysis, separation (as of a compound word into its component parts); वृत्त्यर्थ (समासार्थ) बोधकं वाक्यं विग्रहः. --5 Quarrel, strife (often, lovequarrel or प्रणयकलह); विग्रहाच्च शयने पराङ्मुखीर्नानुनेतुमबलाः स तत्वरे R. 19. 38, 9. 47; Śi. 11. 35. --6 War, hostilities, fighting, battle (opp. संधि), one of the six Guṇas or modes of policy; see गुण. --7 Disfavour. --8 A part, portion, division.
